messages:
jamie: Quick heads-up — Coppergate private rollout is blocked by the customer's firewall/security team. Need a triage ownersync to confirm exact egress + airgap handoff requirements.

maria: Customer asked for an explicit port list + FQDN allowlist for compliance. They can schedule openings next Tue but want details now.

jamie: Can net-eng confirm ports/CIDRs we need? Also onprem team needs the image bundle checklist for airgap.

sunil: High-level: outbound 443 to cloud storage/mirrors, 9443 to our LB for health checks, 123 for NTP, 5222 for agent control channel. Will post precise CIDRs shortly.

sunil: ```
# suggested egress rules for Coppergate
- allow tcp 443 to 52.84.0.0/15  (s3 mirrors)
- allow tcp 443 to 52.219.0.0/16 (oss mirrors)
- allow tcp 9443 to 18.0.0.0/8    (our lb cluster)
- allow udp 123 to 0.0.0.0/0     (ntp)
- allow tcp 5222 to 18.0.0.0/8    (agent channel)
```

karen: For airgap: we need SFTP for tarballs, a checksum manifest, and a target registry path. @maria can you get SFTP host + creds (or a temporary presigned URL)?

maria: I have an SFTP host but legal needs the vendor PO signed before they release creds. Pinging legal now — ETA tomorrow EOD.

aj: Also raising: the canary in staging should have a fallback route to hosted API if kv-cache miss rate >20% to avoid tail latency. Can SRE add that to the deploy plan?

jamie: Action items: sunil -> final CIDRs by EOD; karen -> prep tarball + manifest; maria -> secure SFTP creds or presigned; aj -> add canary fallback rule. I'll update the private-deploy runbook and ownersync notes.

ops-bot: deploybot: Build artifacts queued for coppergate-private v1.2 (id: cg-1789).

sunil: Confirming CIDRs: 52.84.0.0/15, 52.219.0.0/16, 18.0.0.0/8 (our LB), plus customer's NAT egress IPs. Ports: 443, 9443, 123, 5222.

karen: Airgap bundle notes: tarball will include runtime v2.4, model cache snapshot, agent 1.8, and checksum manifest (SHA256) attached to the bundle. We'll also include install instructions and systemd service examples.

jamie: Thanks all. Scheduling an ownersync Wednesday 10:00am PT to go over firewall rules and the SFTP handoff. Anyone blocked for that time?

maria: I can attend but may be ~10-15m late (still waiting on legal).

aj: I'll be on. :thumbsup:

sunil: Works for me.

jamie: Great — I'll post a calendar invite + meeting notes after this thread. If anything changes, ping here.
